_note: The default one-pager. Copy this file to <company>.json and tune `summary`, the chosen bullet ids, and any `text` overrides for a specific job description. Every bullet id must exist in content/career.json — the renderer fails on unknown ids, which is what stops invented claims. This base variant is DOMAIN-NEUTRAL: healthcare standards are trimmed to one item. For a healthcare role, copy it and add the 'domain' skills group and the FHIR/OMOP highlights back.
summary: Senior backend engineer, five years on distributed systems where correctness is not optional - service integration, event-driven architecture, cloud infrastructure, access control and applied ML. Owns systems from design to the CI/CD that ships them.

bullets.text: Built the integration hub's base adapter modules, turning each new EHR integration from a bespoke build into a repeatable pattern
Designed and shipped a full RBAC system across two applications: admin-only endpoint restriction, per-role response filtering and pre-authorization checks
Cut the backend deploy pipeline from 26m33s to 18m07s (-32%)
Modelled clinical protocols and surveys on FHIR resources with OMOP/LOINC terminology; implemented change logs via FHIR provenance
Cut the deployable image from 19 GB to 5.28 GB (-72%) through packaging design
